business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Brokerage of Ginned Raw Cotton and Synthetic Yarns

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 30 May 1984; in force 19 March 1985)
France–China Double Taxation Avoidance Convention (signed 30 November 2013; generally applicable from 1 January 2015)
EEC–China Trade and Economic Cooperation Agreement (1985; in force, binding on France as an EU Member State)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), Articles L. 561-1 to L. 561-57, L. 561-2-2, and L. 561-45 to L. 561-49; French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles R. 123-166 to R. 123-173; Decree No. 2018-284 of 18 April 2018; Regulation (EU) 2015/847 on transfer-of-funds information.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (limited to TRACFIN, judicial authorities, ACPR, notaries, and statutorily obliged AML/CFT entities following the 2022 CJEU restriction on general public access)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, and shareholder registry excerpt of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or statutory corporate registrar in the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (France is a 1961 Hague Convention contracting state); certified French translation required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney authorizing the French representative to sign the SARL articles of association and complete Guichet Unique filing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's country of residence or French consular notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Convention states; for non-Convention states, French consular legalization; certified French translation required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and proof of resident address for all natural-person shareholders, managers, and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the residence country, French consulate, or licensed foreign certification officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostilled or notarially certified true copy; certified French translation required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank certificate of capital deposit on a blocked share-capital account (attestation de blocage de fonds)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French credit institution or Caisse des Dépôts holding the SARL share capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic French banking instrument; no apostille or consular legalization required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory customer and beneficial-owner due diligence under the French Monetary and Financial Code; screening of all UBOs, shareholders, managers, and counterparties against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions database, UN Security Council sanctions lists, the French Treasury (Direction générale du Trésor) asset-freeze list, and, as a cross-border USD-trade best practice, OFAC SDN and related sanctions lists. Politically exposed persons are identified under CMF Article L. 561-10 and receive enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, and TRACFIN reporting under Article L. 561-15 for any suspicious transaction.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises operated by INPI at https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; RCS records and availability checks via Infogreffe; official publication in BODACC.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory filings and RCS public documents must be in French. A company name may be foreign-language if written in Latin script and accompanied by a French-language translation of the corporate purpose in the articles of association; non-Latin scripts require an official French transliteration for the RCS entry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque; établissement de crédit; société de financement; institution de monnaie électronique
Assurance; mutuelle; réassurance; courtier en assurance
OPCVM; fonds d'investissement; gestion de portefeuille
République; État; ministère; préfecture; mairie; commune; département; région
Police; gendarmerie; armée; justice; tribunal; avocat; barreau
Croix-Rouge; ONU; UNICEF; OTAN; emblèmes officiels
Any word implying public concession, sovereign authority, or regulated professional activity without the prior authorization of the competent minister or supervisory authority
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: French law does not provide a separate statutory name-reservation period in the RCS. Name availability is verified at the time of filing through the Guichet Unique and Infogreffe. If the chosen name is rejected for identity conflict, public-order, or misleading-content grounds, the applicant shall: (1) retain the formal rejection notice; (2) submit a gracieux administrative review request to INPI or the responsible registrar; (3) if refused, file a contentieux appeal before the competent commercial court or the designated registry judge within one month of the refusal; and (4) alternatively, file or oppose a trademark under Articles L. 712-4 to L. 712-11 of the French Intellectual Property Code.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only through a licensed domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) under Articles L. 123-11-2 and L. 123-11-3 of the French Commercial Code; a mere letterbox or post-office address is insufficient. For low-risk international cotton-bale brokerage, a contracted virtual registered office is generally accepted provided the domiciliation agreement is filed and actual management records remain accessible at the domiciliation provider.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated risk below 5% at formation stage for a low-risk standard AML profile; unannounced on-site inspections are not standard RCS procedure. The risk rises to approximately 15–20% if later customs, anti-money-laundering, or transfer-pricing audits are triggered by unexplained cash flows or high-volume raw-cotton trade documentation discrepancies.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed professional fee for CDD, sanctions screening, and TRACFIN-related UBO filing

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title III, Chapter II — Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 to R.223-32, supplemented by Article L.210-2 (constitutive act of a société commerciale) and the Loi de modernisation de l'économie 2008-776 (abolition of minimum share capital).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: INPI — Guichet Unique des formalités des entreprises (single electronic filing window), transmitting to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce in the jurisdiction of the registered office for registration on the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution de société — electronic 'M0' creation file comprising the signed Statuts, bank attestation of capital blocking (attestation de blocage de fonds), publication justificatif of the incorporation notice (avis de constitution) in a legal announcements journal, and the registered-office occupancy certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum: the SARL may be incorporated with a single euro or any higher amount. Cash contributions must be fully subscribed and paid up to at least one-fifth (20%) at incorporation, with the remaining balance payable within five years. The subscribed cash capital must be placed in escrow in a blocked account with a French bank or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations until the Kbis registration extract is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — CONSTITUTION OF FR_SARL. Adopted in Paris by the unanimous written consent of the founders on [Date]. 1. SHARE SUBSCRIPTION — The founders subscribe the whole share capital of €[Amount], divided into [Number] equal shares; cash contributions are paid at least to one-fifth under Article L.223-7 of the Commercial Code, the balance payable within five years, and the bank blocked-deposit certificate will accompany the registration filing. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE — The registered office is fixed at [Address], Paris, within the jurisdiction of the Tribunal de Commerce de Paris. 3. OFFICER APPOINTMENTS — [Full name] is appointed Sole Manager with the broadest statutory powers, being expressly authorized to execute all filings before the Guichet Unique.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Statuts (Articles of Association)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding members acting privately or before a French notaire; a notarized deed is required only if contributors bring in real-property assets.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Statuts in full compliance with Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 of the Commercial Code, stating the legal form, duration of 99 years maximum, corporate name, registered-office address, corporate purpose, share capital breakdown, transferability rules, and the powers of the gérant. Each founder signs every counterpart personally; electronic signatures using eIDAS-compliant certificates are accepted. Place the date and city of signing in the deed.
required_dossiers: Skeleton Statuts drafted for a single-member or multi-member SARL
Valid identity documents of every founder
Kbis extract, articles, and power of attorney of any corporate founder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank, notaire, or the registry challenges a statutory clause, adopt a supplemental agreement amending the contested clause, re-sign the act, and annex it to the file before submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Escrow Deposit of Subscribed Paid-in Capital and Issuance of the Blocking Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any licensed French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary 'capital escalation' account in the company name and deposit the paid-up portion of the cash contributions, being not less than one-fifth of the subscribed cash capital. Instruct the depositary institution to issue the attestation de blocage des fonds / certificat du dépositaire, which the registrar will require; the funds stay frozen until the company is registered and the bank receives the certified Kbis.
required_dossiers: Signed original Statuts
Copy of the identity documents of the persons authorized to operate the account
Funds representing the paid-up capital (wire transfer or cashier's check)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the blocking certificate contains incorrect amounts or beneficiaries, the bank reissues a corrected certificate after presentation of the original Statuts; do not amend the Statuts after the certificate is issued without reissuing it.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Legal Incorporation Notice in a Journal d'Annonces Légales
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A legal announcements newspaper (JAL) authorized by the Préfecture for the département of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select an approved JAL covering the registered-office jurisdiction, deliver the company identifiers (form, name, capital, registered office, corporate purpose, duration, manager identity) and instruct publication of the avis de constitution. Secure the justificatif de parution with its publication date; the notice must be published before the Guichet Unique application is lodged.
required_dossiers: Company identification sheet (form, name, capital, address, purpose)
Identity and domicile of the manager to be mentioned in the notice
Filing instructions signed by the founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL notice carries an error in the corporate name or capital, republish a corrective notice, obtain a second justificatif, and attach it to the registry file; a defective notice may lead the registrar to reject the application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Lodgment of the Constitution File on the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI — Guichet Unique des formalités d'entreprises (https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online M0 / création d'entreprise form, attach the scanned Statuts, the blocked-funds certificate, the JAL justificatif, the declaration by the manager of absence of incapacity/conviction, proof of identity of each founder, and proof of occupancy of the registered office; pay the electronic filing fee and submit. The file is dispatched automatically to the competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce within which the office is located.
required_dossiers: Fully completed M0 creation form
Signed and dated Statuts as scanned copies
Attestation de blocage de fonds issued by the bank
Justificatif de parution in the JAL
Signed declaration of non-conviction of each gérant
Identity document of every founder and of the gérant
Proof of occupation of the registered office (lease, title deed, or domiciliation agreement)
Power of attorney if a proxy submits the application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffe issues a demande de complément or rectification, cure the gap strictly within the 15-day statutory delay by re-uploading the corrected scans; failure to respond closes the file and the whole fee must be paid again on resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration, Allocation of SIREN/SIRET and Delivery of the Kbis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon admission of the file, the Registrar enters the company on the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés, assigns the SIREN number (national identification), the SIRET establishment code, and the NAF code 4620B, and draws up the extract Kbis, the authentic certificate of legal existence and corporate capacity; the company acquires legal personality only from that registration date.
required_dossiers: Approved constitution file (M0) received from the Guichet Unique
Proof of payment of the registry fee
JAL publication justificatif
Bank blocked-funds certificate
Any supplemental document requested by the greffe
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis contains errors in the component data (manager, address, purpose), file a written request for rectification with the greffe supported by the correct deeds; rectification is granted in one to two working days without additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Operational Prerequisites for Cotton Export (Customs, VAT, Employer and Banking Activation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DGDDI (French Customs), Service des Impôts des Entreprises, URSSAF, and the chosen commercial bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for an EORI customs identification number on the DGDDI portal for all export declarations of raw cotton baled goods (HS 5201); obtain the intra-community VAT number (TVA intracommunautaire) for documentary collections and LC operations; activate the final professional bank account by presenting the Kbis; if a staff member is hired, declare the first recruitment to URSSAF within eight days; display the Kbis at the registered office as required by Article R.123-237 of the Commercial Code.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract
SIREN and SIRET allocation slip
Certificate of occupation of the registered office
Export documentation under ISIC 4620 (TC/LC drafts or HS 5201 specifications)
Identity and appointment instrument of the gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Customs EORI allocations are verified individually; in the event of rejection or duplicative registration, resubmit the corrected application via the DGDDI EORI portal, providing the SIREN and the French VAT reference, and, where needed, contact the customs duty carrier section to obtain the clearance reference.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — the establishment exercises pure commercial brokerage in raw cotton and synthetic yarns (NAF 4620B, ISIC 4620), which is a free-access, non-regulated activity. The extract Kbis from the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce constitutes the sole operating title. For export operations with countries outside the European Union, the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) grants the mandatory EU EORI customs identifier.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No separate operational or manufacturing permit exists for this scope. The legal operating instruments are: (i) the RCS registration certificate (extrait Kbis), (ii) the EORI number for EU customs filing of raw cotton bale exports, and (iii) the French intra-community VAT number for cross-border intra-EU transactions settled by SWIFT LC or documentary collection.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL — Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (Île-de-France: DRIEAT), French Ministry of Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / non-classified (NC) — pure warehousing-free brokerage generates no installations classées pour la protection de l'environnement (ICPE) filing. If the company establishes cotton-bale storage above an enclosed surface of 500 m², an ICPE declaration under rubric 1510 (entrepôt couvert) must be filed with the DREAL or the municipal service in the seat's département.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or combustion emission thresholds apply to brokerage without processing. For incidental storage of baled cotton, the environmental compliance standard is limited to ICPE rubric 1510: enclosed storage over 500 m² requires declaration, firewater retention capacity, storage aisle separation, and combustibles notification to the local fire authority; dust management follows the Code du travail VLEP on combustible cotton dust of 5 mg/m³ where occupational exposure occurs.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Office premises open to the public must obtain a fire safety review by the Commission de sécurité under ERP 5th category rules; any warehouse holding cotton bales requires a structural load inspection by an approved contrôleur technique and a firefighting-access certification; the employer must file the Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques (DUER), organize periodic medical visits with the médecin du travail, and post the emergency and fire instructions in the workplace before staff are occupied.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE); taxpayer portal: impots.gouv.fr; corporate registration portal: guichet-entreprises.fr / INPI.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident companies must first appoint a tax representative in France unless they are EU/EEA residents, then file the standard French company or branch registration application (e.g., P0/P2 forms or via the Guichet Unique), obtain a SIREN/SIRET number from INSEE and a comex (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire) from DGFiP. For direct VAT registration without a permanent establishment, a Form CA/CO and appointment of a fiscal representative may be required for non-EU entities. Issuance typically takes 2–6 weeks; the tax ID is used for all indirect tax, wage tax, and corporate income tax filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — SARL is a French limited-liability company subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) on worldwide income in principle, with territoriality limitations for activities performed abroad; profits from raw cotton export brokerage conducted through a French permanent establishment are taxable at the standard 25% rate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Available elections include: (1) option for VAT group (assujetti unique) within the meaning of Article 11 of the VAT Directive; (2) election for the French fiscal integration regime (intégration fiscale) for a 95%-owned group; (3) option for tax consolidation within the EU under certain conditions; (4) statement of hybrid mismatch treatment under the ATAD/ATAD2 transposition (BOI-IS-GPE-20-60); (5) for eligible small businesses, the option for the normal VAT regime rather than the franchise de TVA. For SARLs, a check-the-box-style election is not available under French law; tax classification is statutory.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA / Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Franchise en base de TVA: EUR 91,900 for deliveries of goods (2025) and EUR 36,760 for services; however, a taxable person making intra-Community acquisitions in France exceeding EUR 10,000 per calendar year must register without threshold, and foreign businesses making taxable supplies in France from abroad have no de minimis threshold — any export transaction does not trigger registration if the seller is not established in France, but the French importer must self-account for VAT via reverse charge on intra-Community acquisitions; a French-established SARL exporting ginned cotton is required to register for VAT on the basis of its French incorporation alone (no turnover threshold applies).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France mandates a phased interoperability regime: from 1 September 2026 all French taxable persons must receive e-invoices in a structured format for B2B domestic and intra-Community supplies; from 1 September 2027 invoicing for small enterprises becomes mandatory. The clearance architecture requires transmission through the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) or a certified dématérialisation partenaire (PDP) using EN 16931 formats. There is no per-transaction fiscal stamp; e-reporting (e-reporting) of cross-border B2B and B2C transactions is required, and export declarations must be submitted via France's DELTA-G or DESI customs clearance systems, with data cross-checked against e-reporting flows.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of ginned raw cotton from France to a destination outside the European Union are eligible for the 0% VAT rate under Article 262-I of the French General Tax Code (CGI) when three cumulative conditions are met: (1) the goods are physically dispatched or transported out of the EU by the seller or a third party for the customer within 12 months of the sale (oral or written evidence must be available within a reasonable period not exceeding 90 days); (2) the exporter is the taxable person that actually transfers the ownership of the goods to a non-EU buyer, and the goods are destined for a non-EU customer; (3) the exporter holds robust documentary proof of export, including a valid customs export declaration (DAU/DELTA-G), transport evidence (B/L, CMR, air waybill), and evidence of the customer's non-EU establishment. The same zero-rating applies to certain services directly connected with exported goods and to intra-Community supplies (Article 262-III) subject to the buyer's valid VAT number and declaration in the VIES. Offshore supplies of services to non-EU business clients are zero-rated under Article 259-B and Article 262 as long as the place of taxation is outside the EU and the relevant proof of the client's status and effective use is documented.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en douane — DAU / DELTA-G)
Bill of Lading (B/L) or other transport document evidencing departure from the EU (CMR, air waybill, combined transport document)
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a French authorised bank confirming receipt of the export proceeds within the regulatory window
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims of export zero-rating expose the exporter to: reassessment of the full 20% French VAT plus statutory delay interest (0.2% per month); application of the 40% penalty for substantial underpayment (Manquement délibéré) or 80% penalty if the claim is considered an abusive practice or dissimulation (manœuvre frauduleuse); possible criminal tax fraud sanctions under Article 1741 of the CGI consisting of a fine up to EUR 500,000 and 5 years' imprisonment (increased to EUR 1,000,000 and 7 years for organised fraud). The DGFiP and French anti-fraud units (Service National de Douane) may retrospectively audit the past 6 years (extendable to 10 years for fraud against the Treasury) and jointly subject exporters to fiscal and penal clawback proceedings, including seizure and attachment of assets under the Livre des procédures fiscales.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France, operating within the Eurosystem under the oversight of the European Central Bank; French financial-intelligence and anti-money-laundering matters are also administered by TRACFIN and relevant French authorities.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France uses the euro, which is fully convertible for current-account and capital-account transactions, subject to EU and French sanctions, anti-money-laundering, counter-terrorist-financing, tax-reporting, customs, and statistical-reporting requirements. A French SARL may receive foreign capital, pay foreign suppliers, repatriate profits, service shareholder loans, and convert euros into other currencies without a general exchange-control approval. Profit remittance should be supported by approved financial statements, distributable-profit calculations, shareholder resolutions, withholding-tax analysis where applicable, and evidence that the payment is not a disguised capital distribution or prohibited value transfer. Banks may require enhanced due diligence for non-EU shareholders, politically exposed persons, sanctioned or high-risk countries, unusual shareholder loans, circular flows, and payments inconsistent with the company's registered activity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no general statutory obligation to surrender export proceeds to the Banque de France, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no universal statutory deadline requiring conversion of foreign-currency export receipts. Export proceeds may remain in foreign-currency accounts or be converted at the company's discretion, subject to contractual bank terms, accounting in euros, VAT and customs records, sanctions screening, anti-money-laundering controls, and applicable statistical or balance-of-payments reporting. Export evidence, commercial invoices, transport documents, customs declarations, and payment references should be retained for the applicable French accounting and tax record-retention period. Banks may impose internal documentary deadlines before releasing or converting funds, but those are contractual compliance requirements rather than general French exchange controls.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital escrow account for SARL incorporation, followed by operational current account and foreign-currency accounts

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. and the relevant Crédit Agricole regional bank
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital deposit account, operational current account, trade-finance account, and foreign-currency collection account
Capital escrow account, operational current account, documentary-credit account, and multi-currency treasury account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Groupe BPCE, including Banque Populaire or Caisse d'Epargne network entities
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital deposit account and operational account with trade-finance and foreign-currency capabilities subject to entity-level underwriting
Capital deposit account, operating account, and documentary-collection or letter-of-credit account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for supplementary treasury and payment functions, but not a complete substitute for a French relationship bank. A licensed electronic-money institution or payment institution established in the European Economic Area may provide payment accounts, SEPA payments, foreign-exchange execution, and safeguarded customer funds under its applicable authorization and passporting rights. Customer funds held by an EMI are safeguarded and are not equivalent to deposits protected by the French deposit-guarantee regime. An offshore non-EEA EMI generally cannot provide regulated EU payment services into France without an appropriate French or EEA authorization, establishment, or permitted cross-border arrangement. Fintech providers may restrict cotton-origin countries, trade corridors, correspondent banks, cash deposits, documentary credits, high-value transfers, and third-party payments. The SARL should retain a French or EU bank capable of issuing or advising commercial letters of credit, handling documentary collections, supporting customs-related evidence, and maintaining stable correspondent-bank access.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law does not impose a universal requirement that all directors physically attend a bank branch to open a corporate account. Remote onboarding may be permitted following electronic identification, video verification, qualified-signature or equivalent controls, and verification of the legal representative, beneficial owners, tax residence, source of funds, and expected activity. Banks retain discretion to require an in-person meeting, original or certified documents, a French business address, proof of operating substance, or attendance by the legal representative. A capital deposit account may be opened before incorporation using draft constitutional documents and identity evidence; the bank generally releases the capital after receipt of the incorporation certificate and company registration evidence. Non-resident directors and shareholders should expect enhanced scrutiny and possible in-person verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear or layered beneficial ownership, nominee shareholders, trusts, bearer-like arrangements, or inability to identify the ultimate natural-person beneficial owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current articles of association; Kbis extract or registration evidence; ownership chart to each natural-person beneficial owner; shareholder register; passports or national identity documents; proof of residential address; UBO declaration; director appointment evidence; tax-residence information; and written explanation of control rights.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments involving cotton suppliers, buyers, brokers, banks, vessels, ports, or intermediaries connected with sanctioned, embargoed, conflict-affected, or high-risk jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full counterparty identification; sanctions-screening records; country-of-origin and country-of-destination evidence; supplier and buyer contracts; commercial invoices; packing lists; bills of lading; customs declarations; certificates of origin; vessel and port details; beneficial-owner checks; end-use statements where relevant; and documented escalation approval for higher-risk corridors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient evidence of source of capital, shareholder loans, intercompany funding, or unusually large initial deposits inconsistent with the SARL's stated business plan.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed subscription documents; shareholder resolutions; bank statements showing remitting-account ownership; audited or filed financial statements of funding shareholders; loan agreements and repayment terms; tax returns or income evidence where requested; proof of asset sale or financing; capital contribution schedule; and a written funds-flow memorandum.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value third-party payments, cash-intensive activity, personal-account payments, unexplained pass-through transactions, or rapid inbound and outbound movement without commercial margin.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved treasury policy; approved counterparty list; transaction-flow diagram; customer and supplier contracts; purchase orders; invoices; logistics documents; payment approval matrix; bank-account ownership confirmations; reconciliation reports; segregation-of-duties controls; and explanation of brokerage commissions, payment terms, and expected gross margins.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business profile inconsistent with the declared activity, including unexplained commodity volumes, absence of logistics capacity, inconsistent websites or addresses, or lack of evidence of genuine trade.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan; management biographies; office or registered-address evidence; warehouse, freight-forwarding, inspection, and insurance agreements; sample contracts; customer pipeline; supplier due-diligence files; projected monthly payment volumes; expected currencies; countries served; and documented distinction between principal trading, agency, and brokerage activities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax, customs, VAT, or accounting inconsistencies, including missing export evidence, incorrect invoicing, unexplained VAT treatment, or discrepancies between customs values and bank receipts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: French tax-registration evidence; VAT number where applicable; export and import customs declarations; EORI registration; commercial invoices; transport documents; accounting ledgers; VAT returns; reconciliation of invoice, customs, and settlement amounts; transfer-pricing support for related parties; and written advice from the company's French accountant or tax adviser.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For subscribed SARL capital, open a French capital deposit account in the company's formation name, provide draft articles and subscription documentation, and remit funds from an account held by the subscribing shareholder or investor. The payment reference should identify the company, capital subscription, shareholder, and share-issuance purpose. The bank should verify remitter identity, ownership of the remitting account, source of funds, sanctions status, and consistency with the subscription documents. After receipt of the certificate of incorporation or Kbis extract, request the bank's capital-release process and transfer the funds to the operational account. Shareholder loans, additional paid-in capital, and other funding should be routed under separately documented agreements and clearly identified payment references. Use SEPA Credit Transfer for euro payments within the applicable SEPA perimeter and SWIFT cross-border transfer for non-SEPA currencies or corridors. Apply the bank's requested ISO 20022 purpose information or legacy payment-purpose field; France does not impose a general statutory capital-import approval for this activity, but statistical, tax, sanctions, and AML reporting may apply.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for eligible euro payments and SWIFT cross-border transfers for non-SEPA currencies. A SWIFT MT103 is a legacy customer-credit-transfer format increasingly replaced by ISO 20022 pacs.008 messaging; the remitting bank determines the applicable message format. For documentary trade, use an irrevocable commercial letter of credit advised or confirmed by a suitable bank, with invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, inspection certificate, insurance document, bill of lading, and other agreed documents. Documentary collections may use documentary collection instructions under URC 522, including documents against payment or documents against acceptance. Letters of credit should be drafted under UCP 600 and, where applicable, eUCP. Each payment should identify the underlying contract and invoice, avoid prohibited third-party settlement unless documented and approved, and be reconciled to customs, logistics, VAT, and accounting records. The bank may require evidence of shipment, counterparty due diligence, sanctions screening, and confirmation that goods, origin, destination, vessel, and financial institutions are not restricted.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable forward foreign-exchange contracts with an authorized bank for forecast or contracted export receipts and supplier payments, supported by documented exposure, maturity, currency, notional amount, and settlement account.

Currency options or option strategies, subject to bank suitability, documentation, valuation, collateral, and appropriateness requirements. The company should avoid structures whose notional amount materially exceeds documented commercial exposure.

Non-deliverable forwards for currencies subject to local convertibility restrictions or where physical delivery is impractical, provided the counterparty offers the product lawfully, the settlement currency and reference rate are documented, and the transaction is linked to a genuine treasury policy or economic exposure.

Cross-currency swaps or currency swaps for funding or recurring cash-flow exposures, subject to master trading documentation, counterparty-credit approval, valuation, collateral, and accounting controls.

Interest-rate and foreign-exchange derivatives may be subject to EU financial-markets requirements, including EMIR reporting, risk-mitigation, clearing, margin, and classification rules where applicable. The SARL should maintain board-approved limits, ISDA or equivalent documentation, confirmation controls, hedge-accounting analysis where elected, independent valuation, counterparty limits, and periodic effectiveness testing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Turnover Declaration (Déclaration Annuelle de Chiffre d'Affaires - DCA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French Tax Authorities (Direction Générale des Finances Publiques - DGFiP)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after the end of the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalties up to 5,000 EUR and potential company strike-off for non-compliance

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual filing of beneficial owners information to tax authorities within 3 months after fiscal year end, with updates required for any shareholding changes or transfers

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% reduced rate on the first EUR 42,000 of taxable profit for qualifying small businesses (turnover <= EUR 10 million, share capital fully paid and at least 75% held by natural persons); no specific tax holiday for raw cotton bales brokerage; 3.3% social contribution on the corporate tax due in excess of EUR 763,000 for large companies.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite (CGI art. 209: no statutory year cap; annual offset limited to EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000)
